_comment: Map profile. build-save.js --map merchant-quarter. One of these per base map; everything map-specific lives here.

board._comment: Where the physical board sits in TTS units (1 unit = 1 inch). The Mirrored City battlefield frame is centred here.

lighting._comment: Overrides the base save's scene lighting (Merchant Quarter ships a dim purple night). Values as in Options > Lighting. Delete this block to keep the base lighting.

battlefield._comment: Rulebook p.9: typically 30 x 44 inches. Frame drawn on the board; cards spawn outside it, models inside.

ground._comment: Textured tile laid over the board under the terrain. imageFile is relative to tts/ and becomes a file:// URL (local only; upload it to Steam Cloud and switch to imageUrl before publishing). A Custom_Tile is 2 x 2 units at scale 1, so scale = size / 2. Set to null for none.

keep._comment: What survives from the base save. Terrain = Custom_Model / Custom_Assetbundle inside playBox and above the table. Everything else is dropped unless listed.

dropGuids._comment: Terrain whose mesh or texture no longer exists online (pastebin / dead CDN files). They would show as blank models and load errors.

stripUrlPatterns._comment: Any object whose mesh, bundle or image URL contains one of these is dropped; attached child objects and decals that match are removed from the objects that carry them.
